name: Mad Labs - 2g Disposable - Sherbacio
description:
Smooth, sweet, and dessert-rich. The Mad Labs Sherbacio disposable delivers a full 2 grams of premium oil in a sleek, ready-to-go device — no charging setup, no cartridges, no fuss. Just draw and unwind.

Sherbacio is an indica-leaning hybrid that crosses Sunset Sherbert with Gelato, blending two dessert-strain legends into one flavorful package. Expect creamy, sweet sherbet notes up front, layered with hints of fruit, nutty gelato, and a subtle earthy finish. The effect settles in relaxed and mellow — a soothing, feel-good calm that eases the body while keeping a gentle, happy lift, making it a great pick for evenings or kicking back after a long day.

Why you'll love it:

2G of premium oil — long-lasting and built to go the distance
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Sherbacio flavor — creamy sherbet meets sweet, nutty gelato
Relaxed hybrid effects — soothing and mellow, ideal for evenings

Rich flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Mad Labs Sherbacio is ready whenever you are.
